heuristics.statement: For the fixed 64-round SHA-256 walk g on M(x)=zero20||x, the single attempt over one fresh uniform256-bit word succeeds at least as often as the same procedure for a uniformly random256-bit function F. This assumes uniform collision hazard on fresh evaluations, random-mapping iterates, DP density350/2^122 independent of collisions, and persistence of the lazy-sampling hazard despite adaptive trail selection. The proof of the numerical bound concerns F; it does not establish H1 for g.
